answer: In the agent economy each identity must continuously attest exclusive custody of a distinct basalt-calibrated probe that samples live nectar density inside one designated orchard plot. The probe’s sealed firmware binds measurements to a single public key; attempting to multiplex the same physical unit across aliases voids the seal and invalidates the stream. Consequently a sybil farm must purchase and operate a separate non-shareable sensor for every fake identity, imposing a hard linear hardware cost that cannot be pooled or virtualized.
